title: Invoice Minimum for Coordination Corrections by Amount Billed — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — coordination corrections (CO-22).** The billing-error corrections adjusted on the order's patient invoice come off a coordination claim once their total reaches the coordination correction's invoice minimum. The minimum is set by the amount the claim billed at filing:

- below the small claim amount of **250.00 USD** — the small-claim invoice minimum, **1.00 USD**;
- at least 250.00 USD but below the mid claim amount of **1000.00 USD** — the mid-claim invoice minimum, **5.00 USD**;
- 1000.00 USD or more — the standard invoice minimum, **15.00 USD**.

## Boundary pairs

| Billed at filing | Minimum |
|---|---|
| 249.99 | 1.00 |
| 250.00 | 5.00 |
| 999.99 | 5.00 |
| 1000.00 | 15.00 |

## Hypothetical example

A claim billed 1200.00 USD at filing, with billing-error corrections of 12.00 USD on the order's invoice: the minimum is 15.00 USD and is not reached, so none of the corrections comes off. With 15.00 USD of corrections it is reached.
